name: CSAE Conference 2027
organizer: Centre for the Study of African Economies (CSAE), University of Oxford
deadline_note: General deadline; submissions also applying for funding were due 9 August 2026. Call closed on 13 September.
submission_requirements: Full drafts only, with an abstract; one paper per author; English; papers on non-African countries considered if central to development economics in Africa; choose one broad topic (incl. Trade); funding for Africa-based presenters requires attending a pre-conference workshop in Nairobi (30 Nov-4 Dec 2026)
